```{r, fig.width = 8, fig.height = 6, message = FALSE}
proj_root <- rprojroot::find_root(rprojroot::has_file("DESCRIPTION"))
setwd(proj_root)
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = proj_root)
pkgload::load_all(proj_root)
library(tidyverse)
library(future.apply)
```


```{r}
result <- read_csv("aggregated_results/profile_Ahmedabad_hadISD_1997_2011_8_9.csv") |>
  filter(mode == "refined_second", rho >= 0.01) |>
  select(-mode, -profile_var, -source_file)

result |>
  arrange(desc(loglik)) |>
  head(n = 1) |>
  as.data.frame()

params <- get_top_sample(result)

params |>
  predict_model("Ahmedabad",
    n_sims = 1000,
    model = "inf_exponent", covariate = "hadISD",
    start_year = 1997, start_month = 1,
    end_year = 2011, end_month = 12,
    end_year_prediction = 2023, end_month_prediction = 12,
    window_start = 8, window_end = 9,
    dataset = "data/Ahmedabad/dataset_Ahmedabad_2023.csv"
  ) |>
  plot_prediction()

params["scaled_b"] <- 1

plan(multicore, workers = 26)

### allocating the slower ones first speeds up a little (because they start earlier duh)
grid <- expand.grid(window = rev(2:14), rep = 1:10, KEEP.OUT.ATTRS = FALSE)

res <- foreach(
  i = seq_len(nrow(grid)),
  .combine = dplyr::bind_rows,
  .options.future = list(seed = TRUE, packages = c("dplyr", "purrr"))
) %dofuture% {
  w <- grid$window[i]

  result <- params |>
    prediction_by_window(
      city = "Ahmedabad", n_sims = 1000,
      model = "inf_exponent_scaled", covariate = "hadISD",
      start_year = 1997, start_month = 1,
      end_year = 2011, end_month = 12,
      end_year_prediction = 2023, end_month_prediction = 12,
      prediction_window = w,
      window_start = 8, window_end = 9,
      parameters_to_fit = "scaled_b",
      dataset = "data/Ahmedabad/dataset_Ahmedabad_2023.csv",
      output_format = "data.frame", ignore_covid = TRUE,
      actual_end_year = 2011, actual_end_month = 12
    )

  result$parameters_prediction |>
    bind_rows(.id = "year") |>
    as_tibble() |>
    mutate(window = w, rep = grid$rep[i])
}

print(res |> as.data.frame())

write_csv(res, "yearly_prediction_Ahmedabad_hadISD.csv")
```
